system.description: Shadow grows weak when it enters the light. Warriors using this Charm summon their inner light and use it to protect themselves from their strange enemies. Once activated, Light-on-Dark Shield adds the martial artist's Essence to his Parry DV and his bashing and lethal soaks against attacks from creatures of darkness. Against other foes, his Parry DV and soak values increase by only one. At his option, the martial artist can spend a point of Willpower to share this protection with his allies. A halo of shimmering, fiery light forms around the warrior and leaps to his companions, making the Charm Obvious. He can aid no more than (Essence + 1) friends, and each one the warrior wishes to shield costs an additional two motes.
